title: PR 32433 - Keep newer settings edits
summary: Flow: editor state to save request to response. Save A; user types B; response A arrives. Protect B in tested consumers, retain a saved baseline for cancel, and keep editor open when save returns false. Block overlapping save feedback. A stale save can save A on the server while returning false for the current form.
